notes.title: Bugfixes Patch v 0.1.4
notes.content:
Thank you for your feedback!
We're actively working to improve the game and fix all reported bugs.

🛠 Patch Notes
✅ Checkpoint Fixes  Checkpoint 1:          Therapist location resets properly      Room lighting issues fixed      Dialogue can now be skipped; door unlocks instantly      Door closes correctly again        Checkpoint 2:          Figures reset properly      Cleaning assistant returns to default location      Chest resets as expected        Checkpoint 3:          Player position resets correctly      Minigame resets properly      
📘 General Improvements  Added tutorials  Improved overall performance  Increased cassette volume
🐛 Bug Fixes  Fixed issue where player became invisible while attacking  Fixed bug where locked doors opened when clicked rapidly  Fixed flashlight not working  Fixed item interaction in the introduction  Fixed issue where player was visible outside the intended area  Fixed wall clipping while attacking  Added kitchen key directly to inventory
If you encounter any other bugs, please let us know here or via your preferred channel.
We’ll do our best to address them as quickly as possible!
